title: Design System: ojee.console — Instrument Panel (ojee-ui v2)

wordmark.purpose: "ojee.console" in the top bar only, lowercase, same face as everything else.

figures.purpose: The clock readout. Weight 300, tabular, tight leading; 2.4–4.6rem on the status board, 3.4–8.5rem on the idle display.

headline.purpose: A module row's headline fact; 1.12rem in white on the idle display.

reading.purpose: A fact's value: tabular, right-aligned against a dotted leader.

name.purpose: A module's name on its row and fact keys. Names the thing it sits on; never a category line above a heading.

caseline.purpose: Date, zone and time source under the clock.

button.purpose: Button faces: 900 weight caps at 2px tracking.

chrome.purpose: Top-bar segments and .meta. The size floor, used by the chrome only.

motion.name: dur-2
motion.purpose: Immediate feedback: colour and border on hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: --dur and --dur-2 collapse to 0.001s; animations run once; the scene's spin and sway stop

motion.name: scene-sway
motion.purpose: A slow tilt so a line drawing reads as an object.

motion.name: bloom
motion.purpose: Retired; bloomFor() returns 0 for every screen.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: White face, black caps; hover inverts to an outline. The one filled control on a screen.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent with a control-line border; hover takes border and text to white.

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions take err: red caps on a red hairline, filled red on hover.

components.name: Input
components.description: Square field on a faint panel face with a control-line border; focus goes white.

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A display switch (12H, EN) or the crown: line box, caps state word; pressed is white on an 8% white wash.

components.name: Side Rail
components.description: Module list at 1100px and up: grey items, white text on an 8% wash when active, a square status mark at the end.

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Instrument Panel"**

The console is a monochrome instrument panel: a black field, white figures, grey legends, and a lamp that only lights when something is in a state. It replaces the Calibre world (cyan on near-black, a bloomed watch movement, brass/blued/ruby materials, three mono faces). Nothing here is lit for effect. The page is one flat black field, the chrome is opaque, and the only things that carry hue are a reading that reports state and content the console is showing rather than drawing — album art, a device's real LED colour.

The home page is a status board read top to bottom in the order a glance needs it: what is wrong, then the clock and its rate, then one hairline-separated row per module with that module's 3D object drawn small at the row's end as identification. The objects are still white line art in one orthographic scene, but they no longer glow and no longer perform: bloom is off, they turn slowly and sway, and the word beside them always carries the fact.

The system is ojee-ui v2, shipped as `public/ojee-ui2.css`. It keeps v1's class contract so every consumer is a drop-in, and changes the world underneath it. v1 (`public/ojee-ui.css`) stays in the repo **untouched** as the archive of the previous world and for everything not migrated: the native app's offline page (`native/www/`), the `themes/*.css` overlays (calibre, ember, paper), and the `ojee-ui` repo itself, which still ships only v1. Each module repo carries its own copy of `ojee-ui2.css` for its standalone page.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black ground (#000), opaque chrome, one flat field — no backdrop texture, no vignette.
White/grey ink ramp; the accent is white. No cosmetic colour anywhere.
Colour is state: ok green, warn amber, err red, and destructive actions take err.
One face, Geist Mono, at every size; the old `--pixel`/`--hud` tokens survive and resolve to it.
No glow, bloom, blur, or gradient wash; the glow tokens exist and are transparent.
Charts separate series by grey weight and end labels, never by hue.

rules.name: The Colour Is State Rule
rules.body: A hue on screen means a state: ok, warn, err. Nothing is coloured for variety, identity or emphasis — emphasis is white. If a new element wants colour and is not reporting a state, it is grey.

rules.name: The Content Is Data Rule
rules.body: Colour the console shows rather than draws is allowed: album art, a device's real LED colour as a swatch, a screen stream. It is data, so it is not subject to the rule above.

rules.name: The Word And Shape Rule
rules.body: Every coloured state also changes its words or its shape: a module that is down is struck through as well as tinted, the degraded top-bar segment says "1 down", a row that needs attention grows and its headline says what happened. Colour alone never carries the message.

rules.name: The Grey Ladder Rule
rules.body: A chart separates series by weight of grey and by an end label, never by hue. If eight greys are not enough, the chart has too many series.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono only. A display face, a pixel face, a serif for the clock: none of them. The wordmark is the same face as a table cell.

rules.name: The Room Floor Rule
rules.body: The idle display is read from across a room: nothing under 0.8rem, names at 0.85rem, headlines in white, and no reading in dim.

rules.name: The Opaque Chrome Rule
rules.body: Bars, rails and sheets are solid or absent. No frosted glass, no translucency over content, no backdrop blur.

rules.name: The Nothing Glows Rule
rules.body: No `box-shadow`, `text-shadow` or bloom used as light or lift. If a thing must read as forward, it gets a brighter ink or a stronger line.

dos: Do resolve every value to an ojee-ui2 token; a literal colour outside the token block is a bug.
Do spend white on the one thing that is selected, focused, pressed or live.
Do use ok / warn / err only for a state, and err for destructive actions.
Do pair every coloured state with a word or shape change.
Do draw charts on the `--chart-1..8` grey ladder with end labels.
Do keep chrome opaque black with a 1px hairline edge.
Do scope a module's CSS under its own prefix and ship its own copy of `ojee-ui2.css` for its standalone page.
Do stay on the 4/8/16/24/40/64 rhythm and the 44px hit area.
donts: Don't add a hue for identity, decoration, a category or a chart series.
Don't use glow, bloom, `text-shadow`, `backdrop-filter` blur, or a gradient wash.
Don't load a second typeface, or point `--pixel` / `--hud` at one.
Don't put a radius on a box.
Don't box the status board's module rows or turn them into a card grid.
Don't write a module stylesheet with `*` or bare design-system class names (`.panel`, `.btn`, `.label`) as selectors.
Don't edit `ojee-ui.css`; v1 is the archive and the fallback for unmigrated surfaces.
Don't let the 3D scene carry a fact the text does not also say.
